_comment: Is the starting model worth changing before the checkpoint runs? Three centralised cells, one client, no aggregation - the same gate as the other diagnostic configs, so a number here is comparable with the 0.606 f1 already measured for ResNet18 / 128 / num_custom_layers 2. That cell is deliberately NOT repeated: its fingerprint already sits in the diagnostic results CSV and would be skipped anyway. Two questions, one axis each. Resolution: the backbone was pretrained at 224 and is being fed 128, which for a FROZEN backbone costs more than for a fine-tuned one. Depth: ResNet34 was dropped from the grid as the 'does this survive a bigger backbone' control, and this is that question asked cheaply. Same _diagnostic paths as the other two, so nothing reaches the real results CSV.
